description: dekyon with memory: save notes on SessionEnd, checkpoint before compaction, and inject recent notes + lessons on SessionStart

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_end.py"; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_end.py"; else exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_end.py"; fi

if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_start_context.py"; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_start_context.py"; else exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_start_context.py"; fi

if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_end.py"; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_end.py"; else exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_end.py"; fi
